title: Say the shortcut in words too

do.text: Name the chord for screen readers with `accessibilityLabel` ("Command K").

dont.text: Don't leave a chord unnamed where it is the only place the shortcut appears: a screen reader skips it.

do.text: Split a chord into its keys with `KbdGroup`.

dont.text: Don't write a long chord into one cap: it reads as one key named "Ctrl Shift P".
